title: Paxos BUSD wind-down and issuance halt context
summary: Paxos announced it would stop issuing new BUSD and end its relationship with Binance for the Binance USD stablecoin. SOG records this as wind-down context, not as failed status.
notes: Initial regulatory note. Additional NYDFS/regulatory sources should be linked in a later source-deepening pass.

title: SEC action involving Terraform Labs and TerraUSD context
summary: The U.S. SEC announced charges against Terraform Labs and Do Kwon after the Terra ecosystem collapse. SOG records this as regulatory context connected to the UST history, not as a standalone status label.
notes: Initial regulatory note. Legal outcomes and later court actions should be handled in later source-backed updates.

title: USDC banking exposure context during Silicon Valley Bank failure
summary: Circle disclosed USDC reserve exposure to Silicon Valley Bank during the March 2023 banking crisis. SOG records this as banking/regulatory context connected to the recovered USDC depeg event.
notes: This is banking context, not a regulatory action against USDC. Keep separate from status and safety claims.

title: USDC operations reopening context after March 2023 banking weekend
summary: Circle stated that USDC operations would open for business after U.S. federal banking actions during the March 2023 banking weekend. SOG records this as recovery context connected to the recovered depeg event.
notes: Operational recovery context, not a safety score or investment claim.
